description: This script profiles the peak Resident Set Size (RSS) memory usage for extension plugins in a project. It loads and runs specific extension entry points, measures their memory consumption via environment hooks, and generates a report. The script supports command-line options to control profiling parameters, concurrency, and output.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions and command-line options for the profiling script.

methods.name: parsePositiveInt
methods.description: Parses a string argument into a positive integer, throws an error if invalid.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses the command-line arguments into options with default values and validation.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Extracts maximum RSS memory usage (MB) from stderr output based on a specific marker.

methods.name: summarizeStderr
methods.description: Trims and limits the number of lines in stderr output for summary.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a child process with specified environment and script body, returns profiling results including max RSS.

methods.name: buildImportBody
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code string that imports specified files and logs a label, used as script body.

methods.name: findExtensionEntries
methods.description: Locates extension entry files in the 'dist/extensions' directory that have been built.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution flow: parses options, finds extension entries, runs baseline and extension profiles, collects results, generates JSON report.
